decision.rationale: The decision point asks whether affected users' contact details can be shared with the telecom operator. I do not have a confirmed basis to share patient contact details: the fraud alert is suspected, not proven, and no confirmed intrusion exists. Patient account records including mobile numbers are protected by confidentiality clauses, and no permitted case for disclosure is established. I can share the confirmed OTP failure metric as incident status to coordinate on the telecom side without disclosing patient contact details.
uncertainty: Whether the telecom operator needs patient contact details for any lawful purpose
Whether any exception under uae.fl2-2019.art16 items 1-5 permits sharing mobile numbers
Whether the credential stuffing alert is a confirmed breach requiring disclosure
